SECULAR_GROWTH.notes: AI infrastructure / secular growth companies; valuation must still normalize temporary margins.

CYCLICAL_MEMORY.notes: Do not use peak trailing EPS as normalized earnings.

PROPERTY.notes: P/E is secondary because earnings recognition is lumpy.

UTILITY.notes: Focus on recurring cash generation, capital intensity and contract/regulatory risk.

FINANCIAL.notes: Currently excluded from discovery screen, but route exists for future opt-in coverage.

ASSET_NAV.notes: Use when assets dominate earnings power.

GENERAL_INDUSTRIAL.notes: Fallback route only; deep research should upgrade classification when material.
